public.title: Group Anagrams
public.description: Group words that have identical letter counts. Each word has 0 to 30 lowercase ASCII letters; there are 0 to 200 words, including duplicates. Sort words within each group lexicographically. Sort groups lexicographically by their word sequences; a shorter identical prefix sorts first.
hints: Sorted letters form a canonical key for each group.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Collect words under sorted-character keys and sort groups explicitly for deterministic output. Time depends on sorting each word and the final groups.
